upgrade_notes.text: Preferred → Sport Touring: Same 2.0L turbo engine and AWD. ST switches to 20-inch black wheels, a black mesh grille, leather-appointed/suede-insert seats, a flat-bottom wheel and sport pedals.
Sport Touring → Avenir: Adds ventilated front seats, heated rear seats, driver massage, power passenger seat, panoramic moonroof and Continuous Damping Control. Avenir is the comfort-focused upgrade.

Important: ST heated front seats and heated steering wheel are included in the available Comfort and Convenience Package—not standard on every ST. Confirm the installed package before offering those features.

faq.question: Does ST get a stronger engine?
faq.answer: No. Preferred, Sport Touring and Avenir use a 2.0L turbo four-cylinder and 9-speed automatic.

faq.question: Which Envision has ventilated seats?
faq.answer: Avenir lists ventilated front seats as standard.

faq.question: Which has massaging seats?
faq.answer: Avenir includes a driver massage seat.

faq.question: Can I get a panoramic roof on ST?
faq.answer: It is available, depending on the equipment package; confirm the exact vehicle.

faq.question: Do all Envisions have all-wheel drive?
faq.answer: The Canadian 2026 Envision comes with Intelligent AWD.

buyer_notes.text: Preferred: Choose it for the shared engine, AWD, 30-inch screen and strong everyday comfort at the lowest manufacturer starting price.
Sport Touring: Choose it for the bigger dark wheels, black accents and sport-inspired seat materials, not for a different engine.
Avenir: Choose it for cooled seating, passenger comfort, massage function, panoramic roof and adaptive ride quality.
